purpose: Predeclared offline evidence/evaluation harness; no score model is activated.

cohort.membership: Every published immutable game lock in this interval; retain operational exclusions and baseline fallbacks, no filtering by grade/outcome/edge.

r17.status: Failed strict post-training diagnostic; not eligible for promotion or repeated tuning on these outcomes.

requireBeforeEvaluation: Exact artifact/code hash frozen before each eligible decision
Compatible independent model/input release and distribution hash
Predeclared target/reference/feature/source parity and calibration policy
candidate.default: No candidate or missing proof means exact independent baseline; no member or record changes.

source.target: Exact stored paired quote and original cutoff; never substitute later prices
source.referenceExclusion: Union of all evaluated target book families across all model dimensions, or a predeclared common-book+fallback policy
source.forwardClock: providerObservedAt <= fetchedAt <= original decisionAsOf <= approved pregame cutoff
source.missingReference: Exact baseline fallback, counted in full-cohort results
source.sourceParity: Professional-only current quotes cannot silently replace the retail-opening approximate-center information used to fit r17
source.legacy: Never invent missing reference tuples or mutate/reinterpret locks

reports: W/L/push and paired corrections/harms for all three markets
Brier/logloss/calibration by release, odds band and date cluster
Pinned exact-current-price grade promotions/demotions/net actionables/market mix
Source/phase parity and inference applied/fallback counts
acceptance: No automatic pass; all-market/source/timing/held-out and model-change requirements must be satisfied. Failed candidate outcomes cannot become new tuning data presented as holdout.
